tool.name: analyze_pptx_gestalt_tool
tool.description: Interpret a native PowerPoint slide scene graph using deterministic coordinate evidence plus a text model. Produces additive relationship enrichments; it never replaces the native BADGERS spine and does not consume slide pixels.

slide_scene_graph.description: JSON scene graph with normalized (0..1) shape bounds, types, text, groups, and connector endpoints.

scene_graph_uri.description: S3 URI containing the JSON scene graph. Use instead of slide_scene_graph for large graphs.

source_document_path.description: S3 URI or source path of the PowerPoint file.

specialist.name: pptx_gestalt_specialist
specialist.description: Derives evidence-backed spatial and structural relationship enrichments from a native PowerPoint slide scene graph.
